entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit Customer Care, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I feel awful about it.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. Order number is VF7781-B. It's for the Aero Road Helmet.
Okay, Maria, I have your order right here. I see you received the helmet about a week ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's a preference, I guess. It's just... the color wasn't what I thought it would be. It looked different online. I know safety is the most important part of a helmet, and I'm sure it's a great one, but I just won't wear it.
I understand completely. Sometimes things just don't look the same in person as they do on a screen.

Exactly. And the box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really was counting on this money for another purchase. I just feel so disappointed.
No need to feel disappointed, Maria. Let me just pull up our policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on standard items within 90 days of delivery.

Absolutely. Since you received it only seven days ago and the box is unopened, you are well within the return window. I can process this for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Do you still have access to that?
Yes! Oh, that is such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

You're very welcome, Maria. Just print that label, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any carrier location. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
